name: TORO
summary: The TOrque-controlled humanoid RObot from DLR, built on the same lightweight, torque-sensing joint technology as DLR's robot arms. Active torque control at almost every joint lets the otherwise stiff robot be made compliant in software, which DLR uses to research whole-body balance, multi-contact motion and safe physical interaction.
notable: Whole-body torque control from lightweight-arm joint technology
Multi-contact balancing (e.g. leaning on a hand)
